Title: Verify Minio client connection with default endpoint
Preconditions: Minio server is running on http://127.0.0.1:9000
Steps:
1. Open the application and navigate to the Minio configuration page. 2. Verify that the Minio client is connected to the default endpoint http://127.0.0.1:9000.

Test Data: Default Minio endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:9000
Expected Result: The Minio client is connected to the default endpoint http://127.0.0.1:9000

Title: Verify Minio client connection with valid credentials
Preconditions: Minio server is running on http://127.0.0.1:9000 with valid access key and secret key
Steps:
1. Open the application and navigate to the Minio configuration page. 2. Enter valid access key and secret key. 3. Verify that the Minio client is connected to the Minio server.

Test Data: Valid access key and secret key
Expected Result: The Minio client is connected to the Minio server with valid credentials

Title: Authenticate with MinIO using access key and secret key with exactly 255 characters (maximum allowed length) and retrieve a file
Preconditions: A file exists in MinIO storage with path 'test/test.jpg'. MinIO server is running and accessible at 'http://127.0.0.1:9000'.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the file retrieval page in the application. 2. Enter the folder path as 'test' and file name as 'test.jpg'. 3. Ensure the MinIO credentials (access key and secret key) are set to exactly 255 characters each. 4. Submit the request to retrieve the file.

Test Data: Folder path: 'test', File name: 'test.jpg', Access key: 'a' repeated 255 times, Secret key: 'b' repeated 255 times
Expected Result: The system successfully authenticates with MinIO and retrieves the file 'test.jpg' with a 200 OK status code and content type 'application/octet-stream'. The file content is displayed or downloaded correctly.
